info.title: Reviews Acceleration
info.description:
The Reviews Acceleration API lets sellers view and enroll items in the Review Accelerator post-purchase program (RAP). Sellers can: 

* View eligible products using the Get RAP post-purchase items API.
* View currently enrolled products using the same API.
* Identify products that reached their review target after enrollment.
* Filter by category and price, sort by item priority, and search by product name or SKU.
* Enroll or disenroll products in bulk using the bulk update item status API.

post.description: Use this endpoint to retrieve items by RAP status (ELIGIBLE, ENROLLED, COMPLETE). Supports category and price filters, search by item name or SKU, and sorting by Walmart-recommended item priority or price.

parameters.description: Scroll cursor for pagination. For the first request, pass "*" to fetch the initial page. For subsequent requests, pass the `scrollId` returned in the previous response.

accessToken.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
accessToken.description:
Access token required for authenticating API requests.

To obtain a token, call `POST https://marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/token` with your client ID and client secret using the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant type. Refer to the [Token API documentation](https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/get-an-access-token) for details.

Pass the resulting token in the `WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN` header with every API request.
